svg.title: Ratchet ceiling history
svg.desc: Normalized line chart of all 12 lint ratchet ceilings (curly, void, nnnull, dup-imports, radix, default-case, nullish, opt-chain, switch-exh, no-shadow, eqeqeq, return-await), Phase-2 type-ratchet out-of-scope errors, and module-boundary ceiling sum over git history.
svg.text: Each series scaled to its own max (see table for raw counts)
